description: Sends an already-sent notification again, exactly as stored — the content cannot be changed on the way out, because the API re-reads the notification itself. Resending creates a NEW notification: the response reports its id, with the original as `resent_from`. Only works on a notification that has already been sent. To send a draft or a scheduled one now, use pushengage_update_notification with status="sent"; to send a changed copy, use pushengage_duplicate_notification. Subscriber-timezone sends cannot be resent, nor can a single A/B variant or a drip or triggered campaign notification. Each call dispatches a real push to the notification's original audience, so confirm with the user before calling it.

notification_id.description: The notification to act on. Get it from pushengage_list_notifications, or from the notification_id a send tool returned.

name: pushengage_resend_notification
title: Resend a sent notification
